variables = {

    "x5": 1,  # Population structure inference (1 CPU-h, value=2)
    "x6": 3,  # Phylogenetic tree reconstruction (3 CPU-h, value=6)
    "x7": 2  # Multi-omics integration and reporting (2 CPU-h, value=5, depends on T3)
}

objective_function = {
    "x1": 5 * variables["x1"],
    "x2": 3 * variables["x2"],

}

budget_constraint = 8

]

        sense="<=",
        name=f"Precedence Constraint ({variable1} < {variable2})",

solver = QUBOSolver()
